title: Vireo Growth Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-14
summary: Vireo Growth Inc., a Canadian-domiciled emerging growth company, acquired The Hawthorne Gardening Company from Scotts Miracle-Gro Company on April 8, 2026. The transaction was funded through issuance of 213,000,000 subordinate voting shares at $0.60 per share (~$127.8M value) plus warrants to purchase 80,000,000 shares at $0.85. Chris Hagedorn was appointed to the board. This is a routine corporate M&A filing with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Vireo Growth Inc. acquired The Hawthorne Gardening Company LLC from Scotts Miracle-Gro Company via securities purchase agreement
Transaction closed April 8, 2026; total consideration was 213,000,000 subordinate voting shares at $0.60 per share
Company also issued warrants to purchase 80,000,000 shares at $0.85 exercise price, immediately exercisable, expiring in five years
Seller received board nomination rights (Chris Hagedorn appointed) and participation rights to maintain ownership percentage in future offerings
Vireo is a British Columbia incorporated emerging growth company listed on OTC markets (if listed at all); Hawthorne Companies include HGCI LLC and Hawthorne Hydroponics LLC
Lock-up agreement restricts sales: 10% released at 6 months, 30% at 12 months, 30% at 18 months, 30% at 24 months post-closing
